items.summary: Humanoid and canine robots are deployed to a sacred Chinese mountain for unspecified tasks or demonstrations.

items.title: EgoHSI3R: Online 4D Hand-Scene Interaction Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
items.summary: This paper introduces EgoHSI3R, a method for online 4D reconstruction of hand-scene interactions from egocentric video, crucial for embodied learning by consistently recovering hands, camera, and scene in 3D.

items.title: FlowMoDE: Coarse-to-fine Flow Matching for Detail-aware Sim-to-Real Monocular Depth Estimation
items.summary: FlowMoDE proposes a coarse-to-fine flow matching approach for monocular depth estimation, enabling generative models to reconstruct fine structural details crucial for 3D spatial perception in robotic systems.

items.title: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
items.summary: This research evaluates visuomotor skills and offline proxies for dexterous robotic manipulation, analyzing how imitation learning policies perform in real-world scenarios despite variations in object pose, appearance, and environment.

items.title: FlapSim: A Composable MuJoCo Simulation Platform and Reduced-Order Aerodynamic Model Hierarchy for Flapping-Wing Robotics
items.summary: This paper presents FlapSim, an open-source MuJoCo simulation platform for flapping-wing robotics, which provides a modular framework for combining robot descriptions, wing geometry, and aerodynamic models to reconcile high-frequency aerodynamics with slower flight dynamics.

items.title: Confidence-Modulated Safety Filtering for End-to-End Policies
items.summary: This research proposes Confidence-Modulated Safety Filtering for end-to-end policies, a method to ensure the safe operation of robot foundation models and task-specific controllers by wrapping them in a safety filter that considers their operational design domain.

items.title: STAR: Steering Action Representations during Inference
items.summary: This paper introduces STAR (Steering Action Representations during Inference), a method to improve vision-language-action models (VLAs) by preserving task-relevant visual and semantic information in action representations, enhancing their capabilities in robotic manipulation.

items.title: Contact Imitation Interface: Transferring Dexterous Skills by Showing How Contact Unfolds
items.summary: This paper introduces Contact Imitation Interface (CIMI), a method that allows robots to learn human-like dexterous manipulation by processing robot-free human demonstrations, focusing on contact-grounded observations and actions.

items.title: TRACE: Target-State Risk-Aligned Conditional Execution for Embodied Tracking
items.summary: This research introduces TRACE (Target-State Risk-Aligned Conditional Execution), a method for embodied visual tracking in robots that improves persistence in following language-specified persons while mitigating safety violations by using a compact vision-language-action (VLA) tracker.

items.title: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: This research explores Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation, demonstrating how multimodal foundation models like ChatGPT-6-Astra can be adapted through physical experience to perform diverse manipulation tasks in real-world settings.

items.title: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
items.summary: This research proposes a method for Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning that couples a body-agnostic world model with differentiable ego-dynamics, allowing for effective motion planning in cluttered environments for various robot geometries and dynamics.

items.title: HIPC: Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control via Goal-Conditioned Motion Closure
items.summary: This paper introduces HIPC (Humanoid Iterative Planning and Control), a method that combines generative models with controllers for humanoid tracking, enabling adaptive motion planning and reducing spatial drift.

items.title: HandMimicX: Learning Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation via an Object-Centric Policy from Egocentric Videos
items.summary: This paper presents HandMimicX, a method for learning human-like dexterous robotic manipulation using an object-centric policy derived from egocentric videos, allowing the transfer of skills from human demonstrations to robot hands with physical plausibility.

items.title: Joint-Health-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Robust Robot Control Under Actuator Degradation
items.summary: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning approach for robust robot control that is aware of the robot's joint health, enabling it to function despite actuator degradation.

items.title: Geometry-Aware Humanoid Retargeting via Manifold ODEs
items.summary: This research presents a method for geometry-aware humanoid retargeting that transfers human demonstrations to humanoids while preserving spatial relationships with objects and terrain.

items.title: DiffWBC: Unlocking Steerable General Humanoid Motion Tracking via One-Step Diffusion Whole-Body Control
items.summary: This paper presents DiffWBC, a one-step diffusion model for whole-body control, enabling steerable and general humanoid motion tracking that adapts online.

items.title: MolmoSpaces-CommonSense: Evaluating Commonsense in Robotic Manipulation Policies
items.summary: This work introduces MolmoSpaces-CommonSense, a benchmark designed to evaluate commonsense reasoning capabilities within robotic manipulation policies, especially in cluttered and partially observable environments.

items.title: Physically Constrained Kinematic Calibration for High-Precision Robotic Needle Guidance
items.summary: This research details a physically constrained kinematic calibration method to achieve high-precision robotic needle guidance for minimally invasive medical procedures.

items.title: SAFARI: Semantic- And Frontier-driven Autonomous Risk Inspection
items.summary: This paper describes SAFARI, a system for semantic- and frontier-driven autonomous risk inspection, enabling robots to explore unknown hazardous areas and construct risk-aware maps.

items.title: Contact-based optimization for collision-free motion planning for a million robots
items.summary: This research presents an approach for contact-based optimization to achieve collision-free motion planning for large multi-agent robotic systems.

items.title: A complete analytical characterization of optimal collision-free motion for two robots
items.summary: This paper offers a complete analytical characterization for optimal collision-free motion planning specifically for two robots within multi-agent robotic systems.

items.title: RTPolicy: Real-Time (32.9 Hz) Multi-View Visuomotor Policy for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
items.summary: This work introduces RTPolicy, a real-time multi-view visuomotor policy designed for efficient robotic manipulation on edge devices, addressing the need for low inference latency.

items.title: Direct Action-Manifold Modeling for Efficient and Robust Bimanual Manipulation
items.summary: This research proposes Direct Action-Manifold Modeling as a method for efficient and robust bimanual robotic manipulation, aiming to reduce latency compared to iterative denoising methods.

items.title: $\nabla$Mimic: Ultra-Efficient Humanoid Control with Differentiable Simulation
items.summary: This paper presents $\nabla$Mimic, an ultra-efficient method for humanoid control that utilizes differentiable simulation to improve policy learning without requiring enormous sample counts.

items.title: ResMerge: Residual Policy Learning and Merging for Continual Adaptation of Pre-trained Robot Policies
items.summary: This paper proposes ResMerge, a method for residual policy learning and merging that allows pre-trained robot policies to continually adapt to new tasks efficiently.

items.title: OpenVIO: A Versatile Open-Source Visual-Inertial Odometry System
items.summary: This manuscript introduces OpenVIO, a versatile open-source visual-inertial odometry system developed for both robotics research and practical applications.

items.title: Flexibility-Aware Robotic Manipulation: Deformation Estimation, Kinematics, and Control via Distributed Inertial Measurement
items.summary: This paper introduces a flexibility-aware manipulation framework that addresses robotic control with flexible robot links, using deformation estimation, kinematics, and distributed inertial measurements.

items.summary: This article discusses 'architectural robots'—spatial components like partitions, furniture, and facades—that autonomously move and reconfigure in response to occupants' needs.

items.title: Online Learning of Heterogeneous Locomotion Dynamics under Reinforcement Learning Policies for Precise Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: Researchers propose an online learning method using reinforcement learning policies to improve precise loco-manipulation by learning heterogeneous locomotion dynamics and predicting floating-base motion for robots.

items.title: Design and Validation of a Robotic Knee Exoskeleton with Musculoskeletal Simulation-Derived Biological Torque Control
items.summary: A robotic knee exoskeleton is designed and validated using data-driven biological torque control, which estimates and assists based on the user's joint moment, enabling adaptive assistance.

items.title: Suspended-Fabric Robotic Manipulation Surfaces: Modelling, Design Space, and Multimodular Extensio
items.summary: This research explores Suspended-Fabric Robotic Manipulation Surfaces (RMS), a novel system that manipulates objects by deforming a fabric sheet using a sparse grid of vertical linear actuators.

items.summary: Nexus-VLA proposes bridging human and robot experiences for policy learning by using a shared hierarchical semantic latent space to transfer knowledge from large-scale egocentric human videos to robots.

items.summary: ROOF presents a reinforcement learning method enabling humanoid robots to recover from falls, specifically addressing challenges posed by overhead obstacles and integrating contact-supported geometry.

items.title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
items.summary: This paper describes a method for adapting video models for robot control through motion-guided asymmetric prediction, leveraging pretrained video generative models for robotic actions and visual observations.

items.title: E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling
items.summary: E0.5 proposes a framework for robotic world-action modeling, shifting from reconstructive to future-predictive 3D foundations for embodied intelligence. It aims to improve how robots perceive and act in their environment beyond traditional video or vision-language models.

items.title: Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization
items.summary: This research presents a method for learning multi-phase robot loco-manipulation through phase-conditioned policy optimization. It aims to enable robots to execute diverse maneuvers for complex, long-horizon tasks.

items.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
items.summary: This research proposes whole-body humanoid control via stochastic motion tokenization to enable humanoids to perform complex motions. It addresses limitations of velocity-commanded RL policies for humanoids.

items.title: GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers
items.summary: GRAFT introduces geometry-aware residual adaptation for humanoid behavior foundation models to enable them to adapt beyond flat-ground motion. This improves their ability to generate coordinated joint commands for various control tasks.

items.title: A generalist policy for muscle-driven control across individual musculoskeletal models
items.summary: MyoAcross is a framework for developing generalist policies for muscle-driven control across individual musculoskeletal models. It combines model construction, morphology-conditioned policy learning, and virtual model augmentation to enable reference-motion control.

items.title: A Trainable CPG Framework for Quadruped Locomotion
items.summary: CPG-ENN is a trainable framework for quadruped locomotion, combining a symmetry-based central pattern generator (CPG) with a learned execution neural network (ENN). It enables coordinated gait rhythms and motion realization for quadruped robots.

items.title: REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal
items.summary: REACH is an RL-based hierarchical framework enabling humanoid robots, like the Unitree G1, to perform adaptable crawling and traverse confined spaces. It addresses the need for continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes.

items.title: Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos
items.summary: This research focuses on mimetic embodiment transfer to enable humanoids to interact naturally with human partners by preserving spatial, semantic, and contact relationships from in-the-wild videos. It aims to generalize these interactions.

items.title: From Biological Curves to Soft Modular Robots: Learning-Based Inverse Design with Uncertainty-Guided Refinement
items.summary: This research explores a learning-based inverse design method to create soft modular robots that mimic biological shape-changing behaviors, like those of eels or inchworms. It focuses on developing versatile bioinspired robotic systems.

items.title: RoboSTD: Zero-Shot Single-to-Dual Transfer via Sagittal Mirroring for Bimanual Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces RoboSTD, a method for zero-shot transfer of single-arm manipulation data to bimanual robot learning, aiming to reduce the cost of collecting bimanual demonstrations. It focuses on improving bimanual robot manipulation capabilities.

items.title: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
items.summary: This research introduces TOPS, a new approach to reshape flow source and transport for multi-task robot manipulation using language-conditioned policies. It aims to improve the reliable execution of diverse robotic tasks with distinct motion requirements.

items.title: A fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand with human-level joint structure enabled by linkage-based actuation
items.summary: This research describes the development of a fully articulated humanoid dexterous hand with human-level joint structure, achieved through linkage-based actuation. The aim is to enhance robots' ability to perform rich and adaptive physical interactions.

items.title: Integrated Design and Reproducible Feasibility Analysis of a Four-Wheel Rover with Packet-Commanded Imaging, LiDAR Ranging, and Learning-Assisted Target Recognition
items.summary: This study presents an integrated design and feasibility analysis for a four-wheel educational rover, featuring packet-commanded imaging, LiDAR ranging, and learning-assisted target recognition. The rover is intended for the 2027 NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge.

items.title: HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour
items.summary: This research introduces HC2Robot, utilizing hyper-connection transformers with predicted foresight to enable humanoid robots to perform parkour over multi-terrain environments. It addresses challenges in reasoning about future footholds and whole-body motions for complex locomotion.

items.title: When Black-Box Robot Policies Fail: Online Sensor Diagnosis and Repair with a Transparent Surrogate
items.summary: This research investigates online sensor diagnosis and repair for black-box robot policies using a transparent surrogate, addressing issues when robot foundation models rely on faulty sensors. It aims to improve robot reliability by handling corrupted inputs externally.

items.title: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
items.summary: This paper introduces ActiveAlign, a method that improves egocentric robot manipulation by employing active perception, inspired by human interaction, to bridge Real-to-Sim-to-Real gaps caused by passive observation. It enhances structured world representations for planning and execution.

items.title: Structure-Actuation Co-Design of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators
items.summary: This paper introduces a mixed discrete-continuous multiobjective bilevel framework for the co-design of structure and actuation in all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators. It optimizes manipulator geometry and actuation topology to create feasible designs.

items.title: State estimation for a hybrid rigid-continuum space manipulator system
items.summary: This research focuses on state estimation for hybrid rigid-continuum space manipulator systems, which are designed for tasks like on-orbit assembly, repair, and refueling of orbiting assets. It explores integrating soft robotic mechanisms into space manipulator designs.

items.title: Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution
items.summary: This research explores a method using motion primitive graph retrieval to enhance the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies for robotic execution, addressing vulnerabilities to visual shifts.

items.title: Spiking Neuromorphic Control for Periodic Orbits Stabilization in Underactuated Robots: A Greedy Lyapunov-Based Approach
items.summary: This research investigates event-based spiking controllers, implemented as spiking neural networks, for stabilizing periodic orbits and trajectory tracking in underactuated robots.

items.title: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
items.summary: This paper addresses the brittleness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation due to reliance on success-only behavioral cloning, proposing primitive motion learning for human-humanoid skill transfer.

items.title: Generalizable Target-Less Joint Intrinsic-Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Pixel-Point Correspondences
items.summary: This research presents a new generalizable, target-less method for joint intrinsic-extrinsic camera-LiDAR calibration using deep pixel-point correspondences, crucial for robust multi-modal perception in robotics.

items.title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This paper introduces VLA-Stem, a lightweight safety mechanism for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, utilizing reinforcement learning to enable robotic control in environments with spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles.

items.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
items.summary: This research proposes PDRVLA, a Vision-Language-Action model incorporating physical dynamics representations to improve robotic action generation from visual observations and language instructions.

items.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
items.summary: This work explores learning quality-controllable robot policies using iterative hindsight relabeling to dynamically manage execution speed and motion smoothness, beyond simple task completion.

items.title: MimicAll: Structured Embodiment Conditioning for Cross-Humanoid Whole-Body Motion Tracking
items.summary: MimicAll is a reinforcement-learning framework designed for shared whole-body motion tracking across heterogeneous humanoid robots. It accounts for structural and morphological differences to enable diverse behavior reproduction across different humanoid bodies.

items.title: HA-DiPO: Diffusion Policy Optimization for Heterogeneous Cooperative Transport
items.summary: HA-DiPO (Heterogeneous-Agent Diffusion Policy Optimization) is a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework designed for cooperative transport with heterogeneous legged robots. It coordinates diverse motion capabilities to manage unfixed shared payloads.

items.title: Open-World Law-to-Action: Vision-Language Priors and Touch for Parts with Hidden Physics
items.summary: Open-World Law-to-Action (L2A) is a system that allows robots to interact with unknown objects in novel environments, such as opening doors and drawers. It combines vision-language priors with touch sensing to infer hidden physics and execute complex instructions.

items.title: AdaDexTrack: Dynamic Modulation for Adaptive and Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation Tracking
items.summary: AdaDexTrack is a dynamic modulation framework enabling adaptive and generalizable dexterous manipulation tracking for robots commanded by natural language. It addresses challenges in converting instructions into long-horizon, contact-rich hand-object interactions.

items.title: RoboLongR: Causally Consistent Rewards Teach Robots to Progressively Master Long-Horizon Manipulation
items.summary: RoboLongR is an offline-to-online framework that teaches robots to master long-horizon manipulation by learning history-dependent and causally consistent rewards. It guides policy adaptation to new tasks, addressing challenges where visual progress might conceal missing prerequisites.

items.summary: This paper proposes LooM (Loop-invariant Memory) to address memory growth and other limitations in Looped Transformers, aiming to improve causal encoder-decoder language models.

items.title: BenchBench-Cloning: Evaluating Molecular Cloning Design and Protocol Development

items.title: Benchmarking System One Models for Time-Series Decision Making: A Case Study of Jev
items.summary: This paper benchmarks "System 1" decision-oriented models for time-series tasks, exploring their ability to provide accurate predictions and fast decisions, an underexplored area.

items.title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
items.summary: This work audits evaluation artifacts and data leakage in LLM systems for rare disease diagnosis, highlighting risks of bias in reported benchmark accuracies and questioning real-world clinical utility.

items.title: Counterfactual Model Testing Under Distribution Shift
items.summary: This research investigates counterfactual model testing methods to assess how deployed machine learning models degrade under various distribution shifts in input data.

items.title: AlphaIdeaBench: Benchmarking Automated Research Idea Generation under Feasibility Constraints with Peer Review Alignment
items.summary: This paper introduces AlphaIdeaBench, a new benchmark for evaluating automated research idea generation agents that considers feasibility constraints and aligns LLM judgments with peer review.

items.title: InfiniteWorld: Separating Visual Evidence from Familiar Physics
items.summary: InfiniteWorld is a new benchmark designed to evaluate physical reasoning in AI models, specifically testing their ability to follow visual evidence when familiar physics rules no longer apply. It helps clarify whether answers are based on visual evidence or pre-existing expectations.

items.title: Beyond Local Accuracy: Benchmarking the Rollout Reliability of PDE Foundation Models
items.summary: This research benchmarks the rollout reliability of PDE foundation models, investigating whether their short-horizon accuracy translates into reliable long-horizon simulations when predictions are fed back.

items.title: Controlled Evaluation of EEG Foundation Models: Random Initialisation, Band-Power and Validation-Selected Probes
items.summary: This research presents a controlled evaluation of five publicly released EEG foundation models, using rigorous controls like untrained encoders and band-power features, to assess their reported downstream gains.

items.title: Entity-Aware Evaluation of OCR Systems for Historical Document Transcription
items.summary: This paper investigates entity-aware evaluation methods for Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems, focusing on whether meaningful information is preserved in historical document transcription rather than just character error rate.

items.title: The Social World Model Evaluation Gap
items.summary: This paper audits 113 works to evaluate whether current assessment methods for 'social world models' directly test their ability to predict real human responses, identifying an evaluation gap.

items.title: A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models
items.summary: This paper introduces a new benchmark for evaluating controllable speaking-style captioning in audio-language models, which aims to generate natural language descriptions of speech delivery, including paralinguistic attributes.

items.title: Small Edits, Shifting Decisions: Benchmarking LLM Accuracy and Reliability on French Input Variants
items.summary: This paper benchmarks LLM accuracy and reliability on French input variants, such as omitted apostrophes or typos, by constructing a controlled surface-variant benchmark to understand their effects on model performance.

items.title: Mycelium: A Meta-Study of Hallucination Detection Across Provenance, Typology, and Granularities
items.summary: This meta-study, Mycelium, analyzes various methods for hallucination detection in large language models across different provenances, typologies, and granularities. It addresses the challenge of inconsistent definitions and measurements that complicate cross-benchmark interpretation.

items.title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
items.summary: This systematic study explores the design choices that influence the behavior of large language model-based machine translation evaluators. It examines the impact of instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows on evaluation outcomes.

items.title: Detecting Temporal Concepts in Video Transformers via a No-False-Positives Test
items.summary: This research introduces a No-False-Positives Test designed to detect and analyze how video transformer models encode temporal concepts, such as object movement, in video inputs.

items.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
items.summary: AV-FABLE is introduced as a new audio-visual manipulation forensics benchmark for long-form videos, addressing the limitations of existing deepfake benchmarks that focus primarily on short clips.

items.title: WorldFailBench: Do World Models Understand Policy Failures?
items.summary: WorldFailBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate whether world models can understand and predict policy failures in robotic systems. It offers a method for policy evaluation through closed-loop interaction in generated environments, reducing the need for physical testing.

items.title: RoboWorM: Evaluating Movement Realism, Consistency and Acceleration Affects in Embodied Video World Models
items.summary: RoboWorM introduces a method to evaluate movement realism, consistency, and acceleration effects in embodied video world models. It aims to bridge the gap in existing benchmarks by providing stricter 3D spatial and kinematic reasoning for robotic manipulation simulators.

items.title: Behavior Spatial Benchmark: Evaluating Spatial Understanding for Robotics
items.summary: This work introduces BEHAVIOR-Spatial, a benchmark for evaluating robotic spatial understanding, measuring how robots interpret spatial language for tasks like question answering and target grounding.
